newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Clariant predicts good H2 sales.
newsitem.headline: Clariant predicts good H2 sales.

text.p: Swiss specialty chemicals group Clariant AG reported a 12 percent rise in 1997 first half sales on a local currency basis and a 24 percent increase in Swiss francs and said it expected very good sales in the second half.

"The vigorous sales growth reported in the first three months thus continued in the second quarter of 1997. Clariant also expects strong sales figures for the second half of the year," the company said in a statement.
Clariant's first half sales totalled 1.415 billion Swiss francs as compared to 1.139 billion in the 1996 first half.

The company said the Hoechst specialty chemicals business, now integrated into Clariant, also performed very well during the first six months with a significant improvement on the prior-year period. But it provided no details.

Hoechst AG sold its specialty chemicals business to Clariant, retroactive to the start of this year, and is taking a 45 percent stake in the Swiss chemicals group. The European Commission approved the deal in June.
In addition, Clariant said all six of its business sectors contributed to the first half sales increase, which accelerated in the second quarter of 1997 in local currencies.
Clariant expects to give further information on the first six months of 1997 for the enlarged company at media and analysts' meetings on September 23.
